# محبة الحكمة | Mahabat Alhikma

> Mahabat Alhikma (محبة الحكمة, "the love of wisdom") is an Arabic educational platform that turns philosophy into an interactive experience for Moroccan philosophy teachers and students. It combines interactive lessons aligned with the national curriculum, an AI prompt library, Claude-ready teaching skills, educational games, and a curated philosophical media library.
> Created by Mohamed Elyousfi, philosophy educator and AI integration specialist. Primary content language: Arabic (ar). No login or account is required to read any section.

## Sections

- [Philosophy Lessons](https://mahabatalhikma.app/lessons/): Interactive philosophy lessons following the Moroccan curriculum, organized by level, module, and concept — from the problematique, to the philosophers' positions, to the philosophical synthesis. Starts with Personal Identity (2ème Baccalauréat).
- [Philomedia](https://mahabatalhikma.app/philomedia/): Curated philosophical media library — conversations, videos, reels, manga-style visuals, and songs.
- [AI Prompts](https://mahabatalhikma.app/prompts/): Ready-to-use prompts that turn any AI model into a philosophy tutor, Socratic questioner, or debate coach.
- [Educational Skills](https://mahabatalhikma.app/skills/): Claude-ready educational skills for building lessons, research, and interactive learning activities.
- [Games](https://mahabatalhikma.app/games/): Educational philosophy games and thought experiments — philosophy is played, not only memorized.
- [NotebookLM Guide](https://mahabatalhikma.app/notebooklm/): Practical guide for teachers using NotebookLM, Gemini, and ChatGPT in philosophy lessons.
- [AI Booklet](https://mahabatalhikma.app/booklet/): A concise AI guide for philosophy teachers — the three rules, effective prompting, and reusable skills.
- [Feedback](https://mahabatalhikma.app/feedback/): Share your feedback to help improve the platform.

## Optional

- [Homepage](https://mahabatalhikma.app/): Platform overview with every interactive section in one place.
- [Sitemap](https://mahabatalhikma.app/sitemap.xml): Canonical list of all indexable URLs.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/01mohamedelyousfi-design/MAHABATLHIKMA): Static-site source (semantic HTML, Tailwind CSS, deployed on Cloudflare Pages).
